name: clipwright
description: Talking-actor and faceless short videos from your agent, with a free quote before each render.
long_description: Clipwright turns a script into a short vertical video of an actor speaking it, or into a 30 to 90 second faceless video: narration over an opening animated clip and image scenes, with captions. Ask for a quote first: it is free and names the price, the duration and anything the API will not honor. Then start the render; it returns a run id at once, and the video URL arrives when the run succeeds. Output is 1080×1920 by default. Anything the API cannot deliver comes back in `warnings[]` instead of being dropped silently. You can also create a personal actor from a description. Rendering spends credits from your Clipwright account; quotes, voices, the actor catalog and the balance are free. Clipwright does not publish videos anywhere.
